description: This script automates the process of fetching, parsing, and updating a README file with release and version information based on manifest XML files for the Raspberry Pi vendor. It includes functions for fetching XML data, parsing it, generating tables, and replacing placeholders in a template README.

methods.name: fetch_manifest_xml
methods.description: Fetches manifest XML content from a URL constructed with the manifest name and release tag.

methods.name: parse_manifest
methods.description: Parses the manifest XML to extract the Yocto version and a dictionary of layer revisions.

methods.name: generate_table_single
methods.description: Generates a markdown table listing layers and their revisions.

methods.name: generate_table_compare
methods.description: Generates a markdown comparison table between two sets of layer revisions for different release tags.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that processes command-line arguments, fetches and parses manifest data, and updates the README template.
